title: Apple Noodle Kugel
description: A large-batch baked noodle kugel with sliced apples, raisins and a cinnamon-sugar cornflake topping.

steps.instruction: Boil noodles and drain. It's always better to first boil the water, remove from the heat, add the noodles, stir and cover. This will prevent scorched noodles.
Mix all ingredients together in large container.
Distribute evenly in 7 to 10 greased pans.
Mix topping ingredients together and spread evenly over noodles.
Spray surface with cooking spray and cover with aluminum foil.
Place in oven and bake at 350 to 375 degrees F for about 1 hour.
Remove aluminum foil and continue baking until firm to the touch and golden brown. This will only take 5 to 10 minutes at most. Be careful not to burn.

notes: Transcription note: Yield not stated as such; the recipe says to distribute into 7 to 10 greased pans, so yield is recorded as 7 pans (low end of the range).
Transcription note: Oven temperature is printed as a range (350 to 375 degrees F); the step temperature field records 350.
Timing estimated; not stated in original.
Transcription note: Step durations record the stated "about 1 hour" bake and the upper end of the 5 to 10 minute uncovered bake.
